one_liner: Supabase offers a Management API, per-project REST and GraphQL APIs, and an official vendor-run remote MCP server (OAuth login) at mcp.supabase.com; the free tier is self-serve.
auth_notes: The supplied pages show an OAuth authorization-code flow for partner integrations and OAuth for the hosted MCP server. The MCP docs say "You don't need a personal access token (PAT)", which implies PATs exist, and the MCP tools return publishable and legacy anon API keys. Composio lists OAUTH2 and API_KEY. The pages do not document the Management API's auth directly, so confidence is low-to-medium.
access_notes: The pages do not show a free-plan statement directly. The draft's pricing claims came from a page not supplied here, so they cannot be verified. The MCP docs say "Branching (experimental) Requires a paid plan.", implying other features do not need one. The self-serve claim is inferred.
blocker_notes: No blocker is evident in the supplied pages. Branching requires a paid plan, and the pages say nothing about OAuth app registration approval.
